explanation: Bodies 1 (m~10.5) and 3 (m~5.1) fall into a close encounter, separation 0.85 at step 24 -> 0.49 at step 25 -> 0.14 at step 26 (below softening 0.3), with speeds rising 5.7->7.5->9.0 and kinetic 233->355->494. Fixed outer dt 0.032 with max 6 substeps per step cannot resolve the rapidly varying softened force at pericenter, so leapfrog phase error injects energy: total energy jumps from ~2.0 to -91.0 at step 26. Reducing only dt to 0.01 keeps energy constant, confirming under-resolved close encounter, not a force-model bug.
vision_note: The two central bodies move closer over steps 23 to 25 and overlap as a single blob at step 26. The outer bodies stay nearly stationary while the central pair's trails show rapid infall to contact.
